propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts three times per test session (35.93s baseline), violating DRY principle and OSS practice from Setuptools and PyPA Build
session-scoped per-worker fixture must build wheel and sdist once with REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 from git archive, then expose only immutable read-only artifact paths to consumers

wheel-from-sdist and sdist-content tests must reuse shared built artifacts while retaining exact archive-content assertions; install-from-sdist and empty-env failure must remain distinct real builds in function-scoped contexts

a deterministic call-count oracle seeded into the fixture validates exactly one successful prerequisite build per pytest worker/session and fails when duplicate builds or corrupted COMMIT values are introduced
